newsitem.title: USA: Praegitzer sees lower than expected Q1.
newsitem.headline: Praegitzer sees lower than expected Q1.

text.p: Praegitzer Industries Inc said Tuesday that earnings will come in short of analysts' expectations for the quarter ending September 30.

A statement from the company cited changes in product mix as well as higher than anticipated sales, general and administrative expenditures necessary to fully integrate the company's recent acquisition of Trend Circuits Inc.
The company said it expects this difficulty in meeting demand to be temporary.
Praegitzer increased its management and sales staffs due to the integration of Trend Circuits. It said it expects these additional expenditures to have long-term positive effects.
Chief Financial Officer Matt Bergeron, in a telephone interview, said analysts' estimates put the company's earnings at $0.24 to $0.26 per share for the quarter.
"We're going to fall significantly below that," he said. "But it appears we will be in the black on an operating basis."
